title: search_history
description: Input schema for the litany built-in `search_history` tool (ARCH §3.3, docs/DESIGN_CONTEXT_ECONOMY.md §4). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array. Give exactly one of the two properties.

pattern.description: Fixed string (not a regular expression) to search for across every stored transcript entry in this workspace — every agent's history, not just your own. Returns each hit's `<commit>:<path>` address, one per line, then the newest five matching entries verbatim, each cut to its first and last 4096 bytes.

entry.description: A `<commit>:<path>` address from a previous search's listing. Returns that one entry whole.
